tb21_profile.skill: Implement a PTY-backed terminal driver: fork/exec an interactive bash on a pseudo-terminal, manage fds and process groups, inject raw keystrokes including control bytes, and read output without deadlocking.
tb21_profile.domain: Unix tty/process layer from Python - pty, os.fork/execvp, termios, select, signals, subprocess reaping.
tb21_profile.task_form: Implement-from-spec against a supplied abstract base class, in a fixed file path, with behavioural tests that drive the object.

verifier_notes: software-engineering_20260501_172213_011 is graded weak (0.111) but I read tests/test_outputs.py: every test constructs PtyTerminal, sends real keystrokes including \x03, and asserts on side effects the shell must actually produce (file contents, shell responsive after SIGINT, exported var persisting). The assertions are path.exists()/read_text() so the regex scores them cheap, but they are unreachable without a working PTY shell. Same argument applies to 20260415_123352_011 and 20260508_045740_011 (both weak). I therefore kept weak-graded PTY tasks at the top of final_top10. No FREE candidate is in final_top10; the packet-FREE candidates I ranked are all TerminalWorld (tw_84824, tw_96755, tw_682259, tw_17320, tw_32666, tw_8593) and they stay in per_source only; only tw_682259 and tw_32666 are still FREE in the regenerated grade file. NOTE ON GRADES: work/verifier_strength.json was regenerated after work/packets_v2 was built and the two disagree on ~27% of shown candidates (844 of them flip into or out of FREE). Where they disagree I treated a candidate as FREE if EITHER source calls it FREE, so nothing in final_top10 is FREE under either file.
